about: The Lab's class tables (Original Game > Class tables): known classes' tables of functions (vtables), by the address their constructors store at an object's start. Entity names are ours (zoo.exe keeps no class names), found live with the Lab's census; the managers' are zoo.exe's own (zoo.ini [mgr], its text).

0x62f3e4.name: ZTKeeper
0x62f3e4.how: census: keeper, scient, trainer (the animal-care staff share it)

0x630268.name: ZTAnimalType
0x630268.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4b6c51, the species loader (a type's config loader)

0x62e330.name: ZTGuestType
0x62e330.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4c4cb9, the guest type loader (a type's config loader)

0x62e404.name: ZTUnitType
0x62e404.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4b5681 (cNameID, cPurchaseCost, cSwims) (a type's config loader)

0x62e4d8.name: UnitBaseType
0x62e4d8.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4b5faf (cSlowRate, cMinHeight) (a type's config loader); 45 slots, under ZTUnitType's 53: its base

0x62e704.name: ZTMaintType
0x62e704.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4c3d44 (cCleanTrashRadius) (a type's config loader)

0x62e7d8.name: ZTKeeperType
0x62e7d8.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4c34ae (cFoodUnitsSecond) (a type's config loader)

0x62e8ac.name: ZTTourGuideType
0x62e8ac.how: its slot 0x60 is 0x4c406f (cTourGuideBonus) (a type's config loader)

0x6303f4.name: ZTSceneryType
0x6303f4.how: its slot 0x64 is 0x4ba5b0, the scenery loader

0x62dd08.name: ZTFood
0x62dd08.how: census: food (herbchow, put down by a keeper)

0x62ed84.name: ZTStaff
0x62ed84.how: made by ZTStaffType's create (0x6112d9); shares 183-192 of 204 slots with keepers, guides, maintenance

0x62fa44.name: ZTUnit
0x62fa44.how: made by ZTUnitType's create (0x6151b3); the base of animals, guests and staff

0x62de40.name: ZTTankFilter
0x62de40.how: made by ZTTankFilterType's create slot (0x5c -> 0x45d893 -> constructor 0x45d55f), which reads the type's decay and filter delay (x1000 ms)

0x63073c.name: ZTRubbleType
0x63073c.how: its slot 0x64 (0x4c42a2) reads cExplosionSound: only scenery/other/brubble1-4, brubls1, bstump1, bathrubl set it

0x62df78.name: ZTRubble
0x62df78.how: made by ZTRubbleType's create slot (0x5c -> 0x48e370 -> constructor 0x48e343)

0x630544.name: ZTFoodType
0x630544.how: its create (slot 0x5c, 0x4fd1de) makes ZTFood objects; its slot 0x64 reads cKeeperFoodType

0x62e980.name: ZTHelicopterType
0x62e980.how: its create (slot 0x5c, 0x4e5725) makes ZTHelicopter objects; its slot 0x64 reads cLoopSoundName; 0x4e5725 ran first when a DRT base was placed

0x62e630.name: ZTStaffType
0x62e630.how: its create (slot 0x5c, 0x6112d9) makes ZTStaff (0x62ed84) objects; its slot 0x60 is the staff loader

0x62e1e8.name: ZTAmbientAnimalType
0x62e1e8.how: its slot 0x64 (0x4c2ec9) reads cSpeed, cFrequency, cSoundLoop - the ambient birds' keys

0x62fd58.name: UnitBase
0x62fd58.how: made by UnitBaseType's create (0x5ffe36); the base under ZTUnit (likely)
